missing_wings.title: Missing Wings
missing_wings.text: Your plane cannot stay in the sky without wings.
missing_wings.hint: Install a wing pair before testing again.

missing_tail.title: Missing Tail
missing_tail.text: The plane may wobble or turn badly without a tail.
missing_tail.hint: Add a tail so the plane can stay steady.

missing_engine.title: Engine Missing
missing_engine.text: Your plane has no power to move forward.
missing_engine.hint: Install an engine to create thrust.

missing_fuel.title: Fuel Problem
missing_fuel.text: The plane may stop before the trip is complete.
missing_fuel.hint: Add a fuel tank for the mission.

missing_landing_gear.title: Landing Risk
missing_landing_gear.text: The plane may not take off or land safely yet.
missing_landing_gear.hint: Install landing gear before the runway test.

lift_too_low.title: Lift Problem
lift_too_low.text: The plane may not rise into the air.

stability_too_low.title: Balance Problem
stability_too_low.text: The plane may tilt too much while flying.
stability_too_low.hint: Improve the tail or reduce bad part combinations.

thrust_too_low.title: Engine Too Weak
thrust_too_low.text: This engine may not be strong enough.
thrust_too_low.hint: Try a stronger engine or a lighter body.

budget_exceeded.title: Budget Too High
budget_exceeded.text: This build costs more than the mission budget.
budget_exceeded.hint: Choose simpler parts to stay within budget.

pass.title: Ready for Takeoff
pass.text: Great job. This plane looks ready to fly.
